lines: Saifuddin Fakhruddin Qureishi, an Investor Selling Shareholder, sells 2,857,565 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of ₹43.15 crore are scheduled on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Pre-offer retained shares are locked in for 6 months from allotment, so further value may follow later.
Retained holding is unknown: the pre-offer holding is not confirmed from the documents.
